## Modules

- [Weld.Credo.Check.NoRuntimeOsEnv](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Credo.Check.NoRuntimeOsEnv.md): ## Basics
- [Weld.Manifest.Artifact](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Manifest.Artifact.md): Normalized artifact configuration.

- [Weld.Manifest.Output](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Manifest.Output.md): Projection output configuration.

- [Weld.Manifest.Package](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Manifest.Package.md): Package metadata for a generated artifact.

- [Weld.Manifest.Verify](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Manifest.Verify.md): Verification configuration for a generated artifact.

- Public API
  - [Weld](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.md): Graph-native package publication tooling for Elixir monorepos.

  - [Weld.Graph](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Graph.md): Immutable workspace graph wrapper built on top of `Multigraph`.

  - [Weld.Manifest](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Manifest.md): Loads and validates a repo-local weld manifest.

  - [Weld.Plan](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Plan.md): Resolves one artifact view from the manifest and workspace graph.

  - [Weld.Workspace](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Workspace.md): Discovers and loads a monorepo workspace into a graph-native representation.

- Projection And Release
  - [Weld.Affected](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Affected.md): Computes affected projects for one task using Git file diffs and reverse
dependency traversal.

  - [Weld.AgentsVerifier](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.AgentsVerifier.md): Verifies AGENTS.md files carry dependency-source and runtime-env guidance.

  - [Weld.DependencySources](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.DependencySources.md): Verifies repo-local dependency source bootstrap helpers and manifests.

  - [Weld.EcosystemReport](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.EcosystemReport.md): Builds dependency-source reports across a set of repos.

  - [Weld.Lockfile](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Lockfile.md): Stable JSON lock/report artifact for projected builds.

  - [Weld.Projector](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Projector.md): Generates the welded Mix project and its initial lockfile.

  - [Weld.Release](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Release.md): Prepares and archives deterministic welded release bundles.

  - [Weld.SmokeApp](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.SmokeApp.md): Generates a temporary smoke app that depends on the welded package by local
path and compiles it.

  - [Weld.Verifier](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Verifier.md): Runs package-level verification against the generated welded Mix project.

- Workspace And Graph
  - [Weld.Error](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Error.md)
  - [Weld.Git](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Git.md): Thin Git CLI wrapper used for affected-file resolution and release metadata.

  - [Weld.Graph.Edge](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Graph.Edge.md): Classified internal dependency edge between two workspace projects.

  - [Weld.Graph.View](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Graph.View.md): Edge-kind filters for graph traversal and task planning.

  - [Weld.Hash](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Hash.md): Deterministic SHA-256 helpers for files, directories, and in-memory values.

  - [Weld.Violation](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Violation.md): Structured machine-readable policy or graph violation.

  - [Weld.Workspace.Discovery](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Workspace.Discovery.md): Workspace discovery using manifest globs, root Mix adapters, or filesystem
fallback.

  - [Weld.Workspace.Project](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Workspace.Project.md): Loaded Mix project metadata for one workspace member.

## Mix Tasks

- Mix Tasks
  - [mix release.archive](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Release.Archive.md): Archive a prepared welded release bundle using repo-local manifest discovery.

  - [mix release.prepare](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Release.Prepare.md): Prepare a welded release bundle using repo-local manifest discovery.

  - [mix release.track](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Release.Track.md): Track a prepared welded release bundle using repo-local manifest discovery.

  - [mix weld.affected](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.Affected.md): Show which selected projects are affected by a Git diff range.

  - [mix weld.agents.verify](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.Agents.Verify.md): Verify AGENTS.md dependency-source and runtime-env guidance.

  - [mix weld.dependency_sources.verify](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.DependencySources.Verify.md): Verify repo-local dependency source helper and manifest files.

  - [mix weld.ecosystem.report](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.Ecosystem.Report.md): Build dependency-source ecosystem reports for a repo list.

  - [mix weld.graph](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.Graph.md): Render the workspace graph for a weld manifest.

  - [mix weld.inspect](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.Inspect.md): Inspect a weld manifest, discovered workspace, and selected artifact.

  - [mix weld.project](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.Project.md): Generate the welded artifact for a manifest and selected artifact.

  - [mix weld.query](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.Query.md): Query direct dependencies or explanatory dependency paths.

  - [mix weld.release.archive](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.Release.Archive.md): Archive a previously prepared welded release bundle.

  - [mix weld.release.prepare](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.Release.Prepare.md): Prepare a deterministic release bundle for the welded artifact.

  - [mix weld.release.track](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.Release.Track.md): Track a prepared welded release bundle on a projection branch.

  - [mix weld.verify](https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Weld.Verify.md): Generate and verify the welded artifact end to end.
